question: What browser preview ownership and trust model should OpenClaw support before implementing the Dashboard panel?
rationale: The requested panel would expose sensitive browser state and may be implemented either as core Control UI or through a plugin UI surface; automation cannot safely choose that product and security boundary.

options.title: Read-only-first admin panel
options.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs by default while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credential entry, and submit actions.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI entry points
options.body: Defer the browser panel until the generic plugin UI entry-point contract lands, then implement the browser surface as plugin-owned UI under that contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current CLI/RPC screenshot workflow and pause live preview until remote-browser visibility becomes a prioritized product area.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first admin panel
recommendation.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs by default while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credential entry, and submit actions.
